dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "As the one who holds the highest honor among all of us, can't you take this mission a bit more seriously?"

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "...Honor, Yakov. You need to realize that honor is more important than anything else!"

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Chevka, I am sorry for getting everyone involved in this... But I couldn't care less about the kind of honor you keep talking about!"
